question: For each customer and each month of 2020, first calculate the month-end balance by adding all deposit amounts and subtracting all withdrawal amounts that occurred during that specific month. Then determine which month in 2020 has the highest count of customers with a positive month-end balance and which month has the lowest count. For each of these two months, compute the average month-end balance across all customers and provide the difference between these two averages
sql:
WITH all_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
customer_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
),
all_customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month
    FROM customer_ids c
    CROSS JOIN all_months m
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) as total_withdrawals
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_date LIKE '2020-%' AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
customer_month_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        cmb.customer_id,
        cmb.month,
        COALESCE(mb.total_deposits - mb.total_withdrawals, 0) as month_end_balance
    FROM all_customer_months cmb
    LEFT JOIN monthly_balances mb ON cmb.customer_id = mb.customer_id AND cmb.month = mb.month
),
positive_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(*) as positive_customer_count
    FROM customer_month_balances
    WHERE month_end_balance > 0
    GROUP BY month
),
highest_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM positive_counts
    ORDER BY positive_customer_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM positive_counts
    ORDER BY positive_customer_count ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        AVG(month_end_balance) as avg_balance
    FROM customer_month_balances
    WHERE month IN (SELECT month FROM highest_month UNION SELECT month FROM lowest_month)
    GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT month FROM highest_month) as highest_month,
    (SELECT positive_customer_count FROM positive_counts WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) as highest_count,
    (SELECT month FROM lowest_month) as lowest_month,
    (SELECT positive_customer_count FROM positive_counts WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_count,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) as highest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as lowest_avg,
    (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM highest_month)) - (SELECT avg_balance FROM avg_balances WHERE month = (SELECT month FROM lowest_month)) as difference
